title: The Old English Baron: a Gothic Story
sourceTitle: The Old English Baron: a Gothic Story
author: Clara Reeve
description: "The Old English Baron: a Gothic Story" by Clara Reeve is a Gothic novel first published in 1778.
longDescription: When Sir Philip Harclay returns to medieval England, he discovers his dear friend Arthur Lord Lovel is dead and the family estate sold.
